sample: blocks 1-134, the cover pages and front matter
scope_note: Every block in this range was read. Blocks absent from the annotations were read and found to contain no PII; a detection in one of them is a false positive, which is how precision is measured.
sampling_rationale: The front matter carries almost all of the document's contact detail: the registered and corporate offices, the company secretary, both book running lead managers with their contact people, the registrar, and the full promoter list. Annotating a dense region gives a meaningful denominator; annotating all 4,201 blocks by hand was not realistic in the time available.
method: Block text was extracted and read directly, without reference to any output of the tool, so the annotations are not a restatement of what the tool already finds.

conventions.ORGANIZATION: Company names, including trusts and newspapers. Regulators, exchanges, depositories and statutory bodies (SEBI, BSE, NSE, RoC, Registrar of Companies) are NOT annotated: they are named because the law requires it, not because they identify anyone. This matches the tool's stated policy.
conventions.LOCATION: Cities, towns, localities, named buildings and postal codes. Countries and states (India, Maharashtra) are NOT annotated: neither identifies anyone alone.
conventions.PERSON: Personal names. Each occurrence is listed separately.
conventions.not_pii: Corporate Identity Numbers, page references, monetary amounts, share counts, filing and agreement dates, and statute names are deliberately not annotated.
conventions.URL: Company websites. Not one of the assignment's nine types, and annotated anyway: the issuer's name sits inside its own domain, so leaving www.kshinternational.com in place would undo the company-name redaction everywhere else.
conventions.scope_change: URLs were originally excluded and recorded as a known gap. They are now detected, so they are now annotated. This adds to the denominator, so URL numbers cannot be compared against runs made before the change; the report says so rather than presenting the addition as pure gain.
conventions.out_of_scope: Street and plot numbers, such as 11/3, 11/4 and 11/5 in the registered office address, are not annotated. A pattern for them collides with the clause numbers, rule numbers and share counts that fill a prospectus, and the precision cost was judged not worth it. Recorded as a known gap rather than counted against recall.
conventions.block_boundaries: EVEREST FAMILY TRUST is split across blocks 122 and 123 by the document's own layout. Neither half is annotated, since no block-local system could match it. Recorded as a known limitation.
